questions.q: What is the value of 2^5?
7^3 × 7^2 equals which of these?
questions.why: Same base, multiply: add the powers. 3 + 2 = 5, so 7^5.

questions.q: (5^2)^3 equals which of these?
questions.why: Power of a power: multiply the powers. 2 × 3 = 6, so 5^6.

questions.q: What is 10^0?
questions.why: Any number (except 0) to the power 0 is 1.

questions.q: Which is 4,50,000 written in standard form?
questions.why: Put the point after the first digit (4.50000) and count the 5 places moved: 4.5 × 10^5. The option 45 × 10^4 has the right value but is not standard form, because 45 is not between 1 and 10.

questions.q: A rectangle is 15 cm long and 8 cm wide. What is its perimeter?
questions.why: Perimeter = 2 × (15 + 8) = 2 × 23 = 46 cm. (120 would be the area, in cm².)

questions.q: What is the area of a square with side 12 m?
questions.why: Area = 12 × 12 = 144, and area is in square units: 144 m². (48 m would be the perimeter.)

questions.q: A triangle has base 12 cm and height 5 cm. What is its area?
questions.why: Area of a triangle = ½ × base × height = ½ × 12 × 5 = 30 cm². Don't forget the half.

questions.q: A circle has radius 7 cm. What is its circumference? (Use π = 22/7.)
questions.why: Circumference = 2 × 22/7 × 7 = 44 cm. (154 cm² is the area.)

questions.q: A parallelogram has base 9 cm and height 6 cm. What is its area?
questions.why: Area of a parallelogram = base × height = 9 × 6 = 54 cm². There is no half here.

questions.q: How many terms does 4x² − 3x + 7 have?
questions.why: The terms are 4x², −3x and 7. Terms are separated by + or − signs.

questions.q: Which term is a like term to 5xy?
questions.why: Like terms have the same letters and the same powers. yx is the same as xy, so −2yx is a like term.

questions.q: (3a + 2b) + (a + 5b) equals which of these?
questions.why: Add like terms: 3a + a = 4a, and 2b + 5b = 7b. You can't join a's and b's together.

questions.q: What is the value of 2x + 5 when x = 3?
Which expression means 7 more than three times n?
questions.why: Three times n is 3n, and 7 more means + 7. So 3n + 7.

questions.q: What is 15 : 25 in simplest form?
questions.why: Divide both numbers by 5: 15 ÷ 5 = 3 and 25 ÷ 5 = 5. So 3 : 5.

questions.q: What is 20% of 150?
A toy is bought for ₹200 and sold for ₹250. What is the profit percent?
questions.why: Profit = 250 − 200 = ₹50. Profit % = 50 ÷ 200 × 100 = 25%. Always divide by the cost price.

questions.q: What is the simple interest on ₹1,000 at 10% per year for 2 years?
A bag is bought for ₹500 and sold for ₹450. What is the loss percent?
What is the complement of 35°?
questions.why: Complementary angles add up to 90°. 90 − 35 = 55°.

questions.q: What is the supplement of 100°?
questions.why: Supplementary angles add up to 180°. 180 − 100 = 80°.

questions.q: Two straight lines cross. One angle is 60°. What is the angle vertically opposite to it?
questions.why: Vertically opposite angles are equal, so it is 60°. (The angles beside it are 120°.)

questions.q: A linear pair has angles x and 2x. What is x?
questions.why: A linear pair adds up to 180°. x + 2x = 180, so 3x = 180 and x = 60°.

questions.q: Two parallel lines are cut by a transversal. One co-interior angle is 80°. What is the other?
questions.why: Co-interior angles add up to 180°. 180 − 80 = 100°.
